EXPLANATION

Recall that ddt(sinh⁡t)=cosh⁡t⇒∫cosh⁡tdt=sinh⁡t+C,ddt(cosh⁡t)=sinh⁡t⇒∫sinh⁡tdt=cosh⁡t+C.

Therefore, we have

∫(2sinh⁡t+cosh⁡t)dt=∫2sinh⁡tdt+∫cosh⁡tdt=2∫sinh⁡tdt+∫cosh⁡tdt=2cosh⁡t+sinh⁡t+C.

verification.explanation: The worked solution confirms option e. Differentiating 2 cosh t+sinh t+C gives 2 sinh t+cosh t, exactly the integrand.

before.html:
Question 6
?

∫(5csch⁡ycoth⁡y+3cosh⁡y)dy=

a
5sech⁡y+3sinh⁡y+C
b
3sinh⁡y−5csch⁡y+C
c
3sinh⁡y−5sech⁡y+C
d
−5csch⁡y−3sinh⁡y+C
e
5csch⁡y+3sinh⁡y+C
Submit

decision.explanation: Since (csch y)' = −csch y coth y and (sinh y)' = cosh y, the integral is −5 csch y+3 sinh y+C, matching option b.

Question 6
?

∫(5csch⁡ycoth⁡y+3cosh⁡y)dy=

a
5sech⁡y+3sinh⁡y+C
b
3sinh⁡y−5csch⁡y+C
c
3sinh⁡y−5sech⁡y+C
d
−5csch⁡y−3sinh⁡y+C
e
5csch⁡y+3sinh⁡y+C
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Recall that ddy(sinh⁡y)=cosh⁡y⇒∫cosh⁡ydy=sinh⁡y+C,ddy(csch⁡y)=−csch⁡ycoth⁡y⇒∫csch⁡ycoth⁡ydy=−csch⁡y+C.

Therefore, we have

∫(5csch⁡ycoth⁡y+3cosh⁡y)dy=∫5csch⁡ycoth⁡ydy+∫3cosh⁡ydy=5∫csch⁡ycoth⁡ydy+3∫cosh⁡ydy=5(−csch⁡y)+3sinh⁡y+C=3sinh⁡y−5csch⁡y+C.

b
2cosh⁡x−sech⁡x+C
c
 −2cosh⁡x+csch⁡x+C
d
 2cosh⁡x+csch⁡x+C
e
2cosh⁡x+sech⁡x+C
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Recall that ddx(cosh⁡x)=sinh⁡x⇒∫sinh⁡xdx=cosh⁡x+C,ddx(sech⁡x)=−sech⁡xtanh⁡x⇒∫sech⁡xtanh⁡xdx=−sech⁡x+C.

Therefore, we have

∫(2sinh⁡x−sech⁡xtanh⁡x)dx=∫2sinh⁡xdx+∫(−sech⁡xtanh⁡x)dx=2∫sinh⁡xdx−∫sech⁡xtanh⁡xdx=2cosh⁡x−(−sech⁡x)+C=2cosh⁡x+sech⁡x+C.

EXPLANATION

Recall that ddz(csch⁡z)=−csch⁡zcoth⁡z⇒∫csch⁡zcoth⁡zdz=−csch⁡z+C,ddz(tanh⁡z)=sech2⁡z⇒∫sech2⁡zdz=tanh⁡z+C.

Therefore, we have ∫(sech2⁡z+csch⁡zcoth⁡z)dz=∫sech2⁡zdz+∫csch⁡zcoth⁡zdz=tanh⁡z−csch⁡z+C.

verification.explanation: The worked solution confirms option b. Differentiating tanh z−csch z+C gives sech² z+csch z coth z, exactly the integrand.

EXPLANATION

Recall that ddx(cosh⁡x)=sinh⁡x⇒∫sinh⁡xdx=cosh⁡x+C,ddx(tanh⁡x)=sech2⁡x⇒∫sech2⁡xdx=tanh⁡x+C.

Therefore, we have ∫(sech2⁡x−2sinh⁡x)dx=∫sech2⁡xdx+∫(−2sinh⁡x)dx=∫sech2⁡xdx−2∫sinh⁡xdx=tanh⁡x−2cosh⁡x+C.

 5sech⁡y−coth⁡y+C

Correct
EXPLANATION

Recall that ddy(sech⁡y)=−sech⁡ytanh⁡y⇒∫sech⁡ytanh⁡ydy=−sech⁡y+C,ddy(tanh⁡y)=sech2⁡y⇒∫sech2⁡ydy=tanh⁡y+C.

Therefore, we have

∫sech⁡y(5tanh⁡y−sech⁡y)dy=∫(5sech⁡ytanh⁡y−sech2⁡y)dy=5∫sech⁡ytanh⁡ydy−∫sech2⁡ydy=−5sech⁡y−tanh⁡y+C.

EXPLANATION

Recall that

ddt(coth⁡t)=−csch2⁡t⇒∫csch2⁡tdt=−coth⁡t+C.

Therefore, we have

∫(3csch2⁡t+10)dt=∫3csch2⁡tdt+∫10dtdt=3∫csch2⁡tdt+10∫dt=−3coth⁡t+10t+C.

Question 18

∫csch⁡z(7coth⁡z+3csch⁡z)dz=

a
−7csch⁡z−3coth⁡z+C
b
−7csch⁡z+3coth⁡z+C
c
7csch2⁡z−3coth⁡z+C
d
7csch⁡z+3coth⁡z+C
e
−7csch2⁡z−3coth⁡z+C
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Recall that ddz(csch⁡z)=−csch⁡zcoth⁡z⇒∫csch⁡zcoth⁡zdz=−csch⁡z+C,ddz(coth⁡z)=−csch2⁡z⇒∫csch2⁡zdz=−coth⁡z+C.

Therefore, we have ∫csch⁡z(7coth⁡z+3csch⁡z)dz=∫(7csch⁡zcoth⁡z+3csch2⁡z)dz=7∫csch⁡zcoth⁡zdz+3∫csch2⁡zdz=7(−csch⁡z)+3(−coth⁡z)+C=−7csch⁡z−3coth⁡z+C.

Your Answer:
−2coth2⁡t+cosh⁡t+C
